headline: Offered the Library Director job to the preferred candidate and approved the salary offer, both 4-0.
summary: Trustees held a second round of interviews with the Library Director candidate in a closed session allowed for hiring public employees. They voted 4-0 to offer the job to the preferred candidate. They then voted 4-0 to approve the salary offer discussed.
decisions: Approved offering the Library Director job to the preferred candidate, 4-0.
Approved the discussed salary offer for the Library Director position, 4-0.

Salary offer for Library Director position
plain_text:
Town of Londonderry
Leach Library Board of Trustees
Nonpublic Session November 18, 2026
Town Hall, Merrill Conference Room
Meeting called at 6 PM
Members Present:
 Chair Nancy Hendricks
 Vice Chair Beth Marrocco
 Treasurer Azra Palo
 Secretary Erica Laue
Nonmembers Present:
 Colleen Magdziarz, Senior Library Technician
 Jennifer Frenkiewich, Head of Children’s Services
 Library Director candidate
Members Absent:
 Trustee Moira Ryan
 Trustee Jan McLaughlin
Motion to Enter Nonpublic Session made by Secretary Laue at 6:00 PM, seconded by 
Treasurer Palo.
Specific Statutory Reason:
____ RSA 91-A:3, II(b) The hiring of any person as a public employee.
Vote to enter nonpublic session:
 Chair Nancy Hendricks: Yes
 Vice Chair Beth Marrocco: Yes
 Treasurer Azra Palo: Yes
 Secretary Erica Laue: Yes
Discussion points:
 Second round of interview questions for the Library Director candidate.
 Discussion by Trustees, Colleen, and Jen regarding the candidate’s qualifications, 
adaptations to the needs of Londonderry and the Leach Library, and whether the Board 
would like to extend an employment offer to the candidate.
 Motion made by Sectary Laue to extend an offer for the Library Director position 
to the preferred candidate, seconded by Treasurer Palo. Motion passes 4-0.
 Discussion regarding salary.
 Motion made by Secretary Laue to approve the discussed salary offer, seconded 
by Treasurer Palo. Motion passes 4-0.
Motion to leave nonpublic session made by Secretary Laue at 8:08 PM, seconded by Vice
Chair Marrocco.
Vote to exit nonpublic session:
 Chair Nancy Hendricks: Yes
 Vice Chair Beth Marrocco: Yes
 Treasurer Azra Palo: Yes
 Secretary Erica Laue: Yes
Motion to adjourn made by Secretary Laue at 8:09 PM, seconded by Vice Chair Marrocco.
Motion passes 4-0.
Minutes prepared by Secretary Laue.
